name: Thiotepa
halfLifeSource: FDA label for Thiotepa for Injection (thiotepa), Clinical Pharmacology — parent t½ 2.4±0.3 h (60 mg) and 2.3±0.3 h (80 mg) IV
halfLifeNotes: Measured in thirteen female patients with advanced ovarian cancer after intravenous infusion (midpoint of the two dose-level means used); the active metabolite TEPA persists far longer (15.7–17.6 h).
